newsitem.title: USA: Sequoia Systems sets 2-mln shr repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Sequoia Systems sets 2-mln shr repurchase.

text.p: Sequoia Systems Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors had authorised the repurchase of up to two million shares of the company's common stock, adding pessimism about results for this quarter.
The purchases will be made on the open market or in negotiated transactions during the current fiscal year, which ends June 30, 1997.

"Although we do not expect that Sequoia will return to profitability during this quarter, the company's cash position and current market conditions provide an excellent opportunity for the company to repurchase a portion of its shares," J. Michael Stewart, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement accompanying the announcement.
